def transform(grid):
    div=next(i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if r and set(r)=={5})
    below=[row[:] for row in grid[div+1:]]
    bcol=next(v for row in below for v in row if v)

    colors=sorted({v for row in grid[:div] for v in row if v not in (0,5)})
